questions.q: What happens in ArduPlane 4.7.2 with Q_ENABLE = 1 and a reboot?
options: A separate VTOL firmware is loaded instead of ArduPlane
The copter objects are created: the Q_M_ mixer, the Q_A_ and Q_P_ controllers, Q_WP_ navigation
The fixed-wing RLL_RATE_ and TECS_ controllers are disabled until the next reboot of the flight controller
The ATC_ and PSC_ parameters from ArduCopter become available in ArduPlane
questions.explain: QuadPlane::setup() creates objects from the ArduCopter libraries once; the plane half stays, and the copter names get a Q_ prefix.

questions.q: A 4+1 aircraft oscillates in roll in FBWA at a 25 m/s cruise, and there are no QTUN records at that moment. What do you tune?
options: Q_A_RAT_RLL_P and Q_A_RAT_RLL_D
Q_ASSIST_ANGLE and Q_ASSIST_DELAY
RLL_RATE_* with AUTOTUNE
Q_M_THST_HOVER and Q_M_THST_EXPO
questions.explain: QTUN is logged only while the lift motors are active. No QTUN means a pure plane was flying, and the surfaces hold roll through RLL_RATE_*.

questions.q: Which outputs do Motor1–Motor4 land on after Q_ENABLE = 1 with Q_FRAME_CLASS = 1, if SERVO5…SERVO8_FUNCTION were 0?
options: Outputs 1–4, displacing the surfaces
None: motor functions are always set by hand
Outputs 5–8
Outputs 9–12
questions.explain: setup_default_channels(4) assigns Motor1…Motor4 to outputs 5…8, only where the function is 0 and only if the motor is not assigned anywhere yet.

questions.q: Which parameter with the Q_ prefix does the same job as ATC_RAT_PIT_P in ArduCopter?
options: Q_A_RAT_PIT_P
Q_P_D_VEL_P
PTCH_RATE_P
Q_M_THST_EXPO
questions.explain: Q_A_ is AC_AttitudeControl, the same class as the copter's ATC_; in 4.7.2 each has 61 parameters: Q_A_ in the ArduPlane definitions and ATC_ in the ArduCopter SITL dump.

questions.q: Why do the ailerons move in a Q mode in hover?
options: The surface and motor output functions are mixed up
The Q modes also call the fixed-wing stabilization, stabilize_roll() and stabilize_pitch()
Angle-based Q-assist is active
It is SERVO_AUTO_TRIM auto-trimming: in the Q modes it adjusts the surfaces continuously
questions.explain: This is normal: the surfaces stabilize together with the motors (mode_q*.cpp), and at zero airspeed their contribution is small.

questions.q: Arming is refused: "Q_ASSIST_SPEED is not set". What does that mean?
options: The default value of 0: you must set a positive value or −1
The zero offset of the airspeed sensor, ARSPD_OFFSET, is not calibrated
Q_ASSIST_SPEED is above AIRSPEED_MIN
Q_ASSIST_SPEED is not supported on a tilt-rotor
questions.explain: AP_Arming_Plane::quadplane_checks() rejects 0 for every layout except a tailsitter. A positive value enables assistance, and −1 leaves it in transitions only.

questions.q: You set Q_TILT_ENABLE = 1, but the station does not show Q_TILT_MAX, and arming reports "tiltrotor setup not complete, reboot". What do you do?
options: Set Q_FRAME_CLASS = 7
Reboot the flight controller and refresh the parameter list
Set Q_TAILSIT_ENABLE = 1
Set Q_OPTIONS bit 10
questions.explain: ENABLE parameters hide their group while they are 0; the tilt subsystem is initialized only at boot.

questions.q: In what order do you tune a QuadPlane by the module's rules?
options: Fixed-wing AUTOTUNE and TECS, then the transition and Q-assist, and hover last of all, once the wing is already tuned
The transition, then TECS, then Q_A_RAT_*
Hover (notch, Q_A_RAT_*, hover throttle, Q_P_*), then the wing (AUTOTUNE, TECS, L1), then the transition and Q-assist
QAUTOTUNE and AUTOTUNE at the same time in one flight
questions.explain: A Q mode is the recovery mode, so hover is tuned before the first transition; the transition is tuned last, when both halves are stable.

questions.q: You loaded a copter parameter file with ATC_RAT_RLL_P = 0.12 into ArduPlane. What happens?
options: The value is applied to Q_A_RAT_RLL_P automatically
The value is applied to RLL_RATE_P
Arming is refused with "Bad parameter" until the line is removed
The line is not applied: ArduPlane has no such parameter
questions.explain: Copter names do not exist in Plane; you have to rename it to Q_A_RAT_RLL_P and treat the value as a starting point only.

questions.q: On a tilt-rotor in MANUAL the throttle is raised. What do the tilting motors do?
options: They are stopped, like all the other lift motors in MANUAL
They point vertically and hold altitude
They idle at SPIN_ARM
They are tilted forward and work as cruise motors
questions.explain: In a fixed-wing mode without assistance Tiltrotor::continuous_update() tilts them forward and passes the stick throttle through; only the fixed lift motors are stopped.
